scope: A standalone native CREATE SEQUENCE with one resolved automatic owner-column dependency, using an eligible owner relation in its own namespace.

SequenceOwner.role: Exact external relation and column identity for an automatic sequence dependency.
SequenceOwner.structure: Immutable decoded namespace, relation and column identifiers; one native eligible relation kind.
SequenceOwner.conditions: The coordinate is absolute. Session-relative placement uses the current pg_temp namespace. The external interpretation supplies the same declared relation and column under the same authorization.
SequenceOwner.meaning: An automatic dependency on the selected native attribute, including an eligible system attribute when present.

SequenceOwnerKind.role: A native kind that can receive a declared sequence dependency.
SequenceOwnerKind.structure: Ordinary table, foreign table, view, or partitioned table.
SequenceOwnerKind.conditions: Each case describes the corresponding native relation kind.
SequenceOwnerKind.meaning: Select the eligible attachment role and its exact external interpretation.

CreateSequence.role: The fully checked sequence generator with an optional automatic dependency.
CreateSequence.structure: The previous checked sequence value with an optional SequenceOwner.
CreateSequence.conditions: The owner and declaration use the same resolved namespace. The previous construction conditions continue to apply.
CreateSequence.meaning: Create the same generator and record the selected column dependency when supplied. PostgreSQL applies effective authorization equality and subsequent dependency deletion.
CreateSequence.sql: Emit a fully qualified OWNED BY clause when an owner is present.

binding: Resolve the first native eligible relation name in the written schema or visible search path, without skipping earlier incompatible kinds.
Verify native catalog qualification and bind the decoded declared column. Reject missing or ambiguous static targets before publication.
Derive the exact eligible relation kind, including partitioned tables. Preserve declared system attributes that can own a sequence.
Check the exact namespace equality at the owning sequence boundary. Owner role equality at execution is a native authorization condition.
Distinguish OWNED BY NONE from an unresolved selector and preserve duplicate-option rejection.

finite.bound: 120 analyzed and 120 directly constructed coordinates per release. Relative, schema-qualified and validated local-catalog syntax must resolve to the same target in the paired direct observations.

exploration.structure: Vary column names and positions, decoded identifier quoting, typed generator defaults and limits, each owner relation kind, native namespace precedence and guard occupancy.

observations: Exact owner kind, namespace, relation and attribute name; generator shape, all prior unowned effects and actual auto dependency identity and attribute number.
Dependence on deletion of the selected attribute or view; unrelated same-name objects and unrelated attributes remain effective; rollback restores the dependency.
Guarded preexisting relations retain ownership. Native runtime authorization failures retain the other objects and report SQLSTATE 55000.
negativePolicy: The former unsupported owned-by-column witness becomes a positive with its exact declared owner. An unresolved owner and independent wrong-kind, wrong-namespace and wrong-attribute witnesses retain construction boundary coverage.
negative: An owner in a different schema
A declared index shadows the requested owner
An owner with too many coordinate parts
A direct owner from another namespace
A direct schema member depending on a later relation
faults: Attach to the wrong existing named attribute.
Attach to a same-named competing relation.
open: Nested CREATE SCHEMA references that depend on unrelated existing namespaces, ownership of identity sequences, ALTER SEQUENCE and guarded inputs whose invalid operands are skipped by a live existing target.
trust: Exact PostgreSQL process_owned_by semantics and native PostgreSQL dependency observations.
Closed PHP shape, declaration lookup and typed column construction.
requiredEdges: The former exact rejected SQL with its known owner column
An occupied guarded relation retains its previous dependency
Native SQLSTATE 55000 for differing live roles with the same resolved coordinates
